content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides that, where a below-threshold public contract is awarded, the contracting authority must publish information relating to the award on Contracts Finder within a reasonable time.
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: The information to be published on Contracts Finder must at least cover:
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: the name of the supplier
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: the date on which the contract was entered into
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: the value of the contract, and
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: whether the supplier is a small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) or a voluntary community and social enterprise (VCSE).
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: Regulation 112 allows contracting authorities to withhold information in certain circumstances (for example, where publication would impede law enforcement or be contrary to the public interest).
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities must have regard to any guidance issued by the Minister for the Cabinet Office in relation to the form and manner of the information to be published on Contracts Finder and the timescales for publication of this information.
heading_path: Publication of information on Contracts Finder about contracts awarded
Overview
